translated_title: With Mexico, the U.S.’ Largest Trade Deficit
original_title: Con México, el mayor déficit comercial de EU
author: Braulio Carbajal
meta_description: In July, Mexico posted the largest goods trade surplus with the United States among its major partners—US$26.31 billion—and remained America’s top trading partner, U.S. Census data show.
image_warnings: Original La Jornada featured (Cuartoscuro/Archivo) was Cloudflare-blocked; replaced with a public-domain CBP photo of the World Trade Bridge (Laredo), the main Mexico-US truck crossing — landscape, on-topic, marked illustrative.
